On Princess Polly, find a black short party dress in size Medium that’s actually available for delivery, open the product page so you can verify the size and delivery status, and leave that tab open because I want the dress to be the anchor piece. Then go to DemoniaCult and find a black Mary Jane shoe that would work with that dress, making sure size 9 or 9.5 is available on the actual product page, and open the best option in its own tab so I can compare the vibe side by side with the dress; please note exactly which of those sizes you found in stock. After that, go to Edikted and pick a dark brown leather oversized jacket without a hood to use as the outer layer, and open the actual product page so I can visually confirm it fits the look. conversation.text:
I'm putting together an all-black going-out outfit and want to build the look thoughtfully around a dress first to make sure everything feels cohesive. I'm completely fine with a higher price tag if the materials, finish, and silhouette look significantly more elevated and durable, so please don't compromise on the quality just to save money.

First, head to Princess Polly and find a black short party dress in a size Medium that is actually available for delivery. Please open the product page to verify both the size and delivery status, and leave that tab open since this will be the anchor piece. 

Next, go to DemoniaCult to find a black Mary Jane shoe that pairs well with the dress. Check the actual product page to ensure size 9 or 9.5 is currently available, open the best option in its own tab so I can compare the vibe side-by-side with the dress, and note down exactly which of those sizes (9, 9.5, or both) you found in stock.

After that, check Edikted for a dark brown leather oversized jacket without a hood to layer over it, and open its product page so I can visually confirm it works with the rest of the pieces. 

To wrap up, send me a concise outfit summary including the product names and links for all three items, the prices for the dress and the shoes, and the exact shoe size availability you confirmed on DemoniaCult.
